summary: Iteration 3 backend testing of new PDF export feature in AI Advocate (POST /api/pdf/inline + GET /api/pdf/file/{id}). Added 10 new pytest cases. Full suite 52/52 PASSED in 76.49s — no regressions across the 42 prior tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~946 lines (mixing auth, lex, voice, evidence, contracts, lawfirms, PDF, languages). Crossed the 700-line threshold from code-review guidelines; recommend splitting routes (routers/pdf.py, routers/lawfirms.py, etc.) and moving build_pdf into a services/pdf.py module.

POST /api/pdf/inline allows arbitrary title/body/meta of unbounded length from any authenticated user. Consider adding a max length on body (e.g. 200KB) to prevent oversized reportlab builds / memory pressure.

GET /api/pdf/file/{id} does not enforce trial/subscription gating (only ownership). A user with an expired trial can still download PDFs of files created earlier. Likely intentional (read-back of own data) but worth confirming product intent.

Content-Disposition filename in /pdf/file/{id} sanitises to alnum + space/-/_ only — good. But /pdf/inline echoes user-supplied filename verbatim into the header without sanitisation; a crafted filename could break the header (e.g. embedded quotes/CRLF). Recommend reusing the same sanitise routine.

PDF body escapes &/ only; reportlab Paragraph still interprets
from our explicit replacement, but otherwise user text cannot inject HTML — OK. Worth a brief comment in build_pdf for future maintainers.
build_pdf opens /app/frontend/public/assets/logo.jpg per request (fine for low traffic). For scale, cache the bytes once at startup.
No rate limiting on /pdf/inline — a logged-in user can spam PDF generation. Consider per-user throttle if exposed publicly later.
test_credentials: Auto-generated per run via /api/auth/signup (test_<rand>@advocate.app / Test12345!). Pre-seeded test@advocate.app / Test12345! also valid per /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: test_pdf_file_recording seeds one synthetic legal_files doc of type='recording' directly into MongoDB (id stored in state['recording_id']) to exercise the 'recording' PDF branch without invoking real Whisper+Claude.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF export stable. /api/pdf/inline returns application/pdf with bytes starting %PDF; /api/pdf/file/{id} works for letter, evidence, recording (and falls through to 'Contract Analysis' default for any other type). Cross-user 404 enforced via {id, user_id} query in pdf_for_file. Recording type was seeded directly in Mongo to avoid slow STT — if you need to test the real /record/analyze pipeline, expect 30–60s LLM latency.
